blurb: The Finch House is one of North Carolina's most accommodating wedding and event venues. We are located in Thomasville just a few minutes from I-85, within 30 minutes of both downtown Greensboro and Winston Salem. The mansion is over 7,000 square feet and sits on one and a half acres. We offer both indoor and outdoor wedding and reception options. Tables, chairs and linens are included in our packages.
